Full job description
Lowen Talent is seeking a Graduate Associate Consultant to join our Executive Search team in Leeds.
You will work alongside experienced consultants, learning how to identify and engage senior technology leaders.
This is a rare opportunity to build a career in executive search with structured training and genuine progression.
What you'll be doing
Researching and mapping technology leadership markets
Engaging candidates and building long-term relationships
Supporting consultants through the full search lifecycle
What we're looking for
A recent graduate with strong communication skills
Resilience, curiosity and a genuine interest in technology
Full UK right to work is required
